title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT 1+1 TEK URBAN GATE, ASTIR !
description_sq:
Shesim apartament 1+1 ne kompleksin Urban Gate ne zonen e Astirit.
Eshte nje nga komplekset me te mira ne zone dhe me cilesi te mire ndertimi.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6-te banim me orientim jug dhe pamje nga brenda kompleksit.
Disponon nje siperfaqe totale prej 75m2 nga te cilat siperfaqe neto jane 65.1m2.
Eshte nje mundesi e mire banimi dhe investimi pasi zona ofron facilitete te ndryshme per nje jetese me komode.
Apartamenti organizohet ne 1 sallon se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, 1 dhome gjumi me dalje ne ballkon dhe 1 tualet.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT 1+1 FOR SALE AT URBAN GATE, ASTIR!
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in the Urban Gate complex in the area of ​​Astir. It is one of the best complexes in the area and with good construction quality. The apartment is located on the 6th residential floor with south orientation and view from inside the complex. It has a total area of ​​75m2, of which the net area is 65.1m2. It is a good housing and investment opportunity as the area offers various facilities for a comfortable life. The apartment is organized in 1 living room together with the cooking area, 1 bedroom with access to the balcony and 1 toilet. For more information, contact us.
